unchanged_controls: Numerical settings, all B01-B08 criteria, four schema families and five scientific clarifications preserve the original pre-run controls. This portable copy excludes private coordination metadata.
implementation: Independent two-state BE map; independent exponential and integrated-throughput reference; direct compensated Gibbs with initial-C equilibrium. Native endpoints and labeled interpolated common supports; gross increments accumulated independently of state differences.
order: 400,200,100,50,25 s for each forward/reverse/equilibrium. Candidate100 tested against50 and order100/50/25. Only the declared bounded halving policy if candidate fails. All actual outcomes retained, including passing coarse candidates.
auxiliary: A_only/B_only/empty: two complete100000s steps at20tau. Partial_final_step:400s nominal, exact8/lambda+1/(3lambda) endpoint and actual last h.
reference_stability: u=-expm1(-z)/lambda; v small-z convergent series. Direct species Gibbs term eq*((1+y)*log1p(y)-y) with small-y series and continuous c=0 limit; no clipping or epsilon. Binary Gibbs only analytical reference check.
verification: Declared raw residual/minimum, scales/criteria and supports exported. Independent saved-CSV arithmetic/reference/refinement reconstruction. One fresh-output reproducibility comparison after passed checks; no empirical/learner claim.
output: Four full CSV families, verification.json and separate blank/OPEN two-forward-step views. The verified100s policy is fixed, not coarsest passing; full raw tables are in saved-results.zip.
code_freeze: Exact implementation/reference/checker hashes recorded in execution-manifest.json before first numerical command. Code corrections, if necessary, retain prior execution logs and hashes rather than replacing failure history. This records the original execution procedure, not a pre-run freeze of the current checker.
